title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-07-01
lineage: aud> Sony ec M22P mics >Sony 770 MR> R1> DAT> CDR

ai_review.summary: Exceptional audience recording with crystal‑clear Jerry tone and a high‑energy set highlighted by Playin' in the Band, Loose Lucy and a monster Truckin’ → Other One → Space
ai_review.review: The tape captures a vivid “you are there” feel – crisp, modern‑sounding audience mix that many call the best early‑70s aud. Musically the show shines with an incendiary Playin' in the Band, loose Lucy, Half‑Step and a soaring Truckin’ → Other One → Space stretch; Jerry’s guitar is described as aggressive and prime, while Phil “bombs” on The Other One.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating ~4.8 from 22 reviews, overwhelmingly positive comments about both performance and sound quality; consistent praise across many reviewers.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as “modern Neumann on‑stage mix”, crisp, low hiss, great pitch, minimal crowd bleed. A few notes of minor skipping in Truckin' and a slightly short runtime, but overall considered a letter‑perfect audience tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set with classic numbers, exploding second set anchored by Playin' and a marathon Truckin'/Other One/Space sequence; the flow keeps high momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for aggressive, crisp guitar tone (“prime Garcia”, “sweet sweet geetar”), sometimes described as kicked back but still powerful.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted on The Other One where reviewers say Phil "bombs" with his bass.
